tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all projects owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get one project's summary and current workflow step.

tools.name: get_project_episodes
tools.description: List the episodes in a project.

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description: Get one episode record.

tools.name: get_episode_editor
tools.description: Get the full episode tree in one call: project, episode, outline, script, segments, shots, characters, looks, locations and jobs. Prefer this over several narrower calls.

tools.name: get_episode_shots
tools.description: List the shots in an episode.

tools.name: list_episode_segments
tools.description: List the video segments in an episode.

tools.name: get_scene_assets
tools.description: Get one scene with its shots, characters, locations and continuity references.

tools.name: get_project_script
tools.description: Get a project's full script package.

tools.name: get_project_characters
tools.description: List a project's characters.

tools.name: get_character
tools.description: Get one character record.

tools.name: get_character_looks
tools.description: List a character's looks.

tools.name: get_project_locations
tools.description: List a project's locations.

tools.name: get_location
tools.description: Get one location record.

tools.name: get_asset_library
tools.description: List generated assets available to a project.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get one generation job's status and output. Use this to poll a job returned by a generate_* tool.

tools.name: list_project_jobs
tools.description: List generation jobs for a project, newest first.

tools.name: list_shot_continuity_references
tools.description: List the continuity reference images attached to one shot. get_scene_assets also returns these, but only for a whole scene — use this when you need the asset ids, for example to remove one.

tools.name: generate_script
tools.description: Write a full multi-episode script from a story premise. This CREATES A NEW PROJECT — it does not edit an existing one, and it takes no project_id. While the job runs, job.output carries live progress (phase, completedEpisodes, totalEpisodes). On success the new project also has its characters, locat

tools.name: generate_shot_clip
tools.description: Generate a video clip for a single shot (episode_shots row). Spends credits. Returns a job id — poll it with get_job.

tools.name: generate_character_image
tools.description: Generate a reference image for a character. Spends credits. Returns a job id — poll it with get_job.

tools.name: generate_location_image
tools.description: Generate a reference image for a location. Spends credits. Returns a job id — poll it with get_job.

tools.name: generate_shot_background_image
tools.description: Generate an empty background plate for one short shot. Both reference inputs steer what the plate itself looks like — layout, prop identity, materials and lighting — and are unrelated to upload_shot_continuity_reference, which guides clip generation instead. Use reference_image_asset_ids for images

tools.name: generate_episode_music
tools.description: Generate a background music track for an episode. Requires the episode to already have an assembled video. Spends credits. Returns a job id — poll it with get_job.

tools.name: update_shot
tools.description: Overwrite fields on one shot. Read the shot first (get_episode_shots or get_episode_editor), decide the change yourself, then send ONLY the fields you changed — omitted fields are left untouched. To change dialogue, edit camera_setup.short_shots[].dialogue_covered; never send the deprecated `dialogu

tools.name: update_location
tools.description: Overwrite fields on one location. Read it first (get_project_locations or get_location), then send ONLY the fields you changed — omitted fields are left untouched. IMPORTANT: a location is usually shared by several scenes across episodes, so this edit changes every scene that uses it. Check where it

tools.name: upload_shot_continuity_reference
tools.description: Attach an image you produced locally to a shot as a continuity reference. tools.name: attach_shot_continuity_reference
tools.description: Attach an image that already exists in this project to a shot as a continuity reference. tools.name: remove_shot_continuity_reference
tools.description: Detach one continuity reference from a shot. List them first with list_shot_continuity_references to get the asset id. This deletes the reference asset permanently and cannot be undone.
